items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Horace Palm and myself on bass

ctx.x: What was it, three or four man?

Like Lefty on guitar, piano player, Horace Palm and myself on bass, and who the heck was -- we had so many different drummers. Al Duncan, he was the main drummer, because he knew about this back beat.
That was all the go then. They'd record his back beat. Then it'd all depend on how many men they needed for the session. He'd hire extra men.
